req_spec.title: Task creation and text validation
req_spec.scope: README.md TF-REQ-001,002,003,007,008; creation defaults from TF-REQ-004/005/006. Derived acceptance requirements from implemented behavior; no separate customer SRS exists. src/components/TaskFormModal.jsx, Modal.jsx; src/utils/validation.js, tasks.js; src/App.jsx.

requirement.title: Required trimmed title
requirement.description: A blank or whitespace-only title shall show "Title is required." and prevent creation. Source: README.md (Requirements traceability / Exact messages / Behaviour notes); src/utils/validation.js validateTask; src/components/TaskFormModal.jsx handleSubmit; baseline main@5133a6c.

requirement.title: Title inclusive length boundaries
requirement.description: Trimmed title length shall be 3 through 80 Unicode code points inclusive. Below 3 shows "Title must be at least 3 characters." Above 80 shows "Title must be 80 characters or fewer." Inputs have no maxLength. Source: README.md (Requirements traceability / Exact messages / Behaviour notes); src/utils/validation.js TITLE_MIN/TITLE_MAX/countChars; src/components/TaskFormModal.jsx; baseline main@5133a6c.

requirement.title: Trim and Unicode normalization
requirement.description: Leading/trailing title and description whitespace shall be removed before counting and saving. Each Unicode code point, including a single emoji, counts as one. Combining sequences consist of multiple code points; no Unicode canonical normalization occurs. Source: README.md (Requirements traceability / Exact messages / Behaviour notes); src/utils/validation.js countChars/validateTask; src/utils/tasks.js normalizeValues; baseline main@5133a6c.

requirement.title: Optional description maximum
requirement.description: Description may be empty and shall accept up to 500 trimmed Unicode code points. At 501 it shall show "Description must be 500 characters or fewer." and prevent creation. Source: README.md (Requirements traceability / Exact messages / Behaviour notes); src/utils/validation.js DESCRIPTION_MAX/validateTask; src/components/TaskFormModal.jsx; baseline main@5133a6c.

requirement.title: Live trimmed counters
requirement.description: The title and description counters shall display "n / 80" and "n / 500" using trimmed code point counts. counter-over/red shall apply only when n exceeds the maximum. Source: README.md (Requirements traceability / Exact messages / Behaviour notes); src/components/TaskFormModal.jsx titleLength/descriptionLength; src/App.css .counter-over; baseline main@5133a6c.

requirement.title: Creation form defaults
requirement.description: Opening "+ New Task" shall show "New Task", blank title/description/date, priority "Medium", status "To Do", "Cancel" and "Create Task". Empty date saves as an empty string. Source: README.md (Requirements traceability / Exact messages / Behaviour notes); src/components/TaskFormModal.jsx EMPTY_FORM; src/utils/tasks.js normalizeValues; baseline main@5133a6c.

requirement.title: Successful creation and persistence
requirement.description: A valid submission shall close the form, add exactly one task, save it to taskflow_tasks and immediately show "Task created successfully." The saved object has a nonempty generated id and identical valid ISO createdAt/updatedAt on creation. Source: README.md (Requirements traceability / Exact messages / Behaviour notes); src/App.jsx createTask/commit; src/utils/tasks.js buildTask; src/utils/storage.js saveTasks; baseline main@5133a6c.

requirement.title: All creation values retained
requirement.description: A valid creation shall preserve selected priority/status/date and save trimmed title/description without altering internal spaces or line breaks. Duplicate task titles are allowed and receive distinct ids. Source: README.md (Requirements traceability / Exact messages / Behaviour notes); src/components/TaskFormModal.jsx handleSubmit; src/utils/tasks.js buildTask/normalizeValues; src/App.jsx createTask; baseline main@5133a6c.

requirement.title: Cancel creation through every close path
requirement.description: Cancel, Close (X), Escape and pressing the dark backdrop shall close New Task and discard unsaved values, without creating or persisting a task or showing a success toast. Source: README.md (Requirements traceability / Exact messages / Behaviour notes); src/components/TaskFormModal.jsx; src/components/Modal.jsx onKeyDown/onMouseDown/onClose; baseline main@5133a6c.

requirement.title: Fresh creation form on reopen
requirement.description: After dismissal or successful creation, opening New Task again shall use EMPTY_FORM and clear previously displayed validation errors. Source: README.md (Requirements traceability / Exact messages / Behaviour notes); src/App.jsx conditional TaskFormModal mounting; src/components/TaskFormModal.jsx useState; baseline main@5133a6c.

requirement.title: Error timing and focus
requirement.description: Before the first submit validation errors shall stay hidden. Invalid submit shall keep the modal open, show all relevant field errors, set aria-invalid and focus the first invalid field (title before description). Source: README.md (Requirements traceability / Exact messages / Behaviour notes); src/components/TaskFormModal.jsx submitted/errors/handleSubmit/invalid; baseline main@5133a6c.

requirement.title: Live recovery after failed submit
requirement.description: After the first failed submit, errors shall update on each edit. Correcting every invalid field shall permit one successful creation on the next submit. Source: README.md (Requirements traceability / Exact messages / Behaviour notes); src/components/TaskFormModal.jsx handleChange/submitted/handleSubmit; baseline main@5133a6c.

requirement.title: Creation entry points
requirement.description: With no tasks the page shall show "No tasks yet", "Tasks you create will appear here." and "Create your first task". That button shall open the same New Task form as "+ New Task". Source: README.md (Requirements traceability / Exact messages / Behaviour notes); src/components/TaskList.jsx empty state; src/App.jsx onCreate; src/components/EmptyState.jsx; baseline main@5133a6c.

requirement.title: Safe literal text rendering
requirement.description: Task title and description shall render as literal React text, including HTML-like content, without creating injected markup or executing scripts. Source: README.md (Requirements traceability / Exact messages / Behaviour notes); src/components/TaskCard.jsx task.title/task.description; src/components/TaskFormModal.jsx controlled values; baseline main@5133a6c.
